description: Re-run verification for one of the workspace's domains: live-checks the sending identity (DKIM) and DNS routing (MX), saves the refreshed status, and returns it. Call after adding the DNS records get_domain listed, or to correct a stale status. When setup is still incomplete, returns the exact DNS records still needed. Safe and idempotent: it never sends mail or changes content, only refreshes verification state.
name: verify_domain
